definitions.explanation: A state of being in a superior or advantageous position compared to others.

examples.japanese: {価格面|かかくめん}で{優位|ゆうい}な{立場|たちば}にある。
examples.english: We are in an advantageous position in terms of price.

examples.japanese: {技術力|ぎじゅつりょく}の{優位|ゆうい}を{維持|いじ}するために{研究開発|けんきゅうかいはつ}に{投資|とうし}し{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: We continue to invest in R&D to maintain our technological advantage.

notes:
Often used in business, military, and competitive contexts. Can function as a na-adjective ({優位|ゆうい}な) to modify nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{優位|ゆうい}に{立|た}つ (gain the upper hand)
・{優位|ゆうい}を{保|たも}つ (maintain superiority)
・{優位|ゆうい}な{立場|たちば} (advantageous position)
・{優位|ゆうい}に{進|すす}める (proceed advantageously)
・{競争|きょうそう}{優位|ゆうい} (competitive advantage)
